SELECT a.person_id AS entity_id, 'activity' AS source_type, a.id AS source_id, AS interaction_type, a.timestamp AS touched_at, AS weight FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.person_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT n.person_id AS entity_id, 'note' AS source_type, n.id AS source_id, 'workspace-note' AS interaction_type, n.created_at AS touched_at, #{model.noteWeight} AS weight FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND n.person_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.person_id AS entity_id, 'task' AS source_type, t.id AS source_id, 'task' AS interaction_type, t.created_at AS touched_at, #{model.taskWeight} AS weight FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.person_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'activity' AS source_type, a.id AS source_id, AS interaction_type, a.timestamp AS touched_at, AS weight FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.person_id = #{personId} AND a.timestamp IS NOT NULL AND a.timestamp <= #{reference} UNION ALL SELECT 'note' AS source_type, n.id AS source_id, 'workspace-note' AS interaction_type, n.created_at AS touched_at, #{model.noteWeight} AS weight FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND n.person_id = #{personId} AND n.created_at IS NOT NULL AND n.created_at <= #{reference} UNION ALL SELECT 'task' AS source_type, t.id AS source_id, 'task' AS interaction_type, t.created_at AS touched_at, #{model.taskWeight} AS weight FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.person_id = #{personId} AND t.created_at IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at <= #{reference}

SELECT p.id, COALESCE(SUM(touch.weight * POW(#{model.decayBase}, -touch.age_days / #{model.halfLifeDays})), 0.0) AS raw_weight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days <= #{model.recentWindowDays} THEN touch.weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS recent_weight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days > #{model.recentWindowDays} AND touch.age_days <= #{model.priorWindowDays} THEN touch.weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS prior_weight, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(touch.touched_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS last_touch_at, SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days <= #{model.recentWindowDays} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_touch_count FROM person p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT source.entity_id, source.touched_at, source.weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, source.touched_at, #{reference}) / #{model.microsecondsPerDay}) AS age_days FROM (
) source WHERE source.touched_at IS NOT NULL AND source.touched_at <= #{reference} ) touch ON touch.entity_id = p.id WHERE AND p.suspended_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id, COALESCE(SUM(touch.weight * POW(#{model.decayBase}, -touch.age_days / #{model.halfLifeDays})), 0.0) AS raw_weight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days <= #{model.recentWindowDays} THEN touch.weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS recent_weight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days > #{model.recentWindowDays} AND touch.age_days <= #{model.priorWindowDays} THEN touch.weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS prior_weight, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(touch.touched_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS last_touch_at, SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days <= #{model.recentWindowDays} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_touch_count FROM person p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT source.entity_id, source.touched_at, source.weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, source.touched_at, #{reference}) / #{model.microsecondsPerDay}) AS age_days FROM (
) source WHERE source.touched_at IS NOT NULL AND source.touched_at <= #{reference} ) touch ON touch.entity_id = p.id WHERE AND p.suspended_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS contributor_count, COALESCE(SUM(capped.base_weight * POW(#{model.decayBase}, -capped.age_days / #{model.halfLifeDays})), 0.0) AS total_decayed_contribution, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.source_type = 'activity' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.source_type = 'note' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS note_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.source_type = 'task' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS task_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.age_days <= #{model.recentWindowDays} THEN capped.base_weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS recent_weight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.age_days > #{model.recentWindowDays} AND capped.age_days <= #{model.priorWindowDays} THEN capped.base_weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS prior_weight, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(capped.touched_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS last_touch_at, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.age_days <= #{model.recentWindowDays} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS recent_touch_count FROM ( SELECT source.source_type, source.touched_at, source.weight AS base_weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, source.touched_at, #{reference}) / #{model.microsecondsPerDay}) AS age_days
) capped

SELECT aged.source_type, aged.source_id, aged.interaction_type, DATE_FORMAT(aged.touched_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS occurred_at, aged.base_weight, aged.base_weight * POW(#{model.decayBase}, -aged.age_days / #{model.halfLifeDays}) AS decayed_contribution, provider_activity.provider_name, provider_activity.provider_stream, provider_activity.provider_source_id, DATE_FORMAT(provider_activity.provider_captured_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS provider_captured_at, CASE WHEN provider_activity.provider_owned THEN DATE_FORMAT(#{reference}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS capture_as_of, provider_activity.provider_visibility, provider_activity.provider_admitted_fields_json, provider_activity.provider_material_exclusions_json FROM ( SELECT source.source_type, source.source_id, source.interaction_type, source.touched_at, source.weight AS base_weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, source.touched_at, #{reference}) / #{model.microsecondsPerDay}) AS age_days
) aged LEFT JOIN activity provider_activity ON aged.source_type = 'activity' AND provider_activity.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND provider_activity.id = aged.source_id ORDER BY decayed_contribution DESC, aged.touched_at DESC, aged.source_type, aged.source_id LIMIT #{limit}
